title: Astro Portal API v1 sky quality
description: GET /v1/sky-quality query and response (packages/portal/src/planner/sky-quality.server.js). Public read: a thin wrapper over the same monthly-cached Bortle/SQM estimate the web planner reads, sampled from the self-hosted VIIRS Nighttime Lights raster, whose cells hold the radiance of everything within 300 km summed with a distance kernel rather than the radiance of the cell itself. A present Authorization header must still be a valid device bearer. The queried coordinates are never echoed back. `source` names the annual composite the installed raster was built from, so it carries the year rather than a fixed value.

calibration.description: Additive, optional: `<calibration-set version>/<region id>` (e.g. "2026-09/japan", "2026-09/global") from the regional table in packages/portal/src/sky-quality.js. Not required so an older client, or a fixture recorded before this field existed, still validates; a client MAY treat a cached estimate whose `calibration` differs from the current one as stale.
